summary: This is a routine Form 6-K reporting the initial drawdown of a previously announced senior secured credit facility. New Found Gold Corp., as issuer, received $70M from EdgePoint under a $105M facility. Terms include a 2% original issue discount and issuance of 2,489,818 warrants at C$3.30 per share. The funds are for general corporate purposes and mine development. No merger, tender, or special situation change of control is involved; this is standard project financing.
